title: Welcome Canvas: mini-tour templates, scaffolded empty states & contextual tips
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Deliver a cohesive set of onboarding UI assets for the Console first-run experience. Scope includes: a compact "mini-tour" template (3-panel micro-tour), a scaffold for first-run checklist states, responsive screenshot mocks (desktop/tablet/mobile), contextual tip tooltips, and illustrative empty-state variants for the main Console routes (Models, Deployments, Billing, Logs). Deliverables must include Figma source, exported PNG/JPEG screenshots at three breakpoints, a naming convention guide, motion specs for the micro-tour (simple fade/slide), and final microcopy strings localized for EN-US. Key goals: reduce time-to-first-success for new users, clearly communicate next actions for empty routes, and provide assets that engineering can implement without additional creative iterations.
acceptance_criteria: Exported screenshots for Desktop (1440w), Tablet (900w), Mobile (375w) following naming guide
Microcopy set (title, subtitle, CTA, secondary action) for each empty state in an attached CSV
Handoff package includes Lottie sample or CSS keyframe spec for micro-tour transition
Accessibility notes: color contrast checks, keyboard focus order, aria labels included in handoff doc
engineering_dependencies: ENG-5123: onboarding-first-run-state-api (needs route flags for mini-tour)
ENG-5890: empty-state-renderer-component (should accept illustration, title, ctas)
reviews: 2026-02-18 - PM review by Liam Prescott: 'Prefer stronger action verbs on CTAs for Deployments empty state; please propose two variants'
2026-02-22 - Eng sync with Sasha Patel: 'Can implement as static assets; request we provide an options JSON for micro-tour steps (title, copy, icon, targetSelector)'
2026-02-24 - Accessibility review by Kim Ortega: 'Contrast OK for primary CTA; suggest bolder focus ring and explicit aria-describedby for tips'
decisions: Use three-step mini-tour instead of full modal walkthrough to reduce cognitive load
Illustrations will be single-color SVGs with token-driven fills to support theme switching
Provide micro-tour as declarative JSON (list of steps) rather than imperative JS to simplify engineering integration
tradeoffs: Kept animation minimal (fade + slide) to avoid perf regressions on low-end devices
Chose single-color illustrations to accelerate localization and theming at expense of richer visuals
notes_and_feedback: PM asked for A/B test between checklist-first vs. tour-first flows; added to follow-up ticket PM-421
Design QA: screenshot exports include 2x and 3x assets for retina — confirm with ENG if required
